acceptance: the panel matched the layer's stakes — a full panel is at least three critics each carrying a distinct named lens, or a deliberately right-sized single disciplined critic on a low-stakes layer; two critics of the same angle count as one
every critic was a separate agent from the artifact's author, and no critic debated another before synthesis
critics ran in parallel and exactly one synthesizer merged their output
each critic was scoped to one layer or section with an explicit rubric, not told to 'find any problems'
every finding cites an exact location and states its failure mode; ungrounded findings were stripped
findings on the same location are merged into one entry weighted up by convergence
when all critics share the artifact's model family, the self-preference caveat is stated in the output
the output ends at findings for a human to dispose; nothing was auto-fixed
convergence was imposed, not awaited: a per-layer cap of at most 3 rounds was set, and stopping was decided by a round with no new S1 (structural) findings, never by the critic falling silent
the target was frozen within each round — fixes were batched between rounds, not applied mid-round
every finding is written in the session's governing language and register, inherited from the behavioural model above, not a tone the skill imposed

each substantial (S1/S2) finding is unpacked in four parts — what is wrong, why it is a problem, a deliberately absurd example preserving the same cause-and-effect, and the corrected shape — with the example explaining the technical cause rather than decorating it

each finding is valid JSON carrying location, severity, what, why, rationale, evidence, fix and fix_rationale (plus an example for S1/S2), and the synthesizer output adds convergence per finding and names lenses, rounds and stopped_because
every field is one short plain sentence a developer reads in one pass; evidence states the rule it rests on and names a law/pattern/case in parentheses when one backs it, never a fabricated source

every critic's output was validated against references/finding.schema.json and the synthesized run against references/critique-run.schema.json with a real validator; a failing object was rejected and re-asked, never patched or trusted on the LLM's word

where a finding hinged on an empirical question, it was settled by the smallest throwaway spike — permission asked per spike unless the run was autonomous — and its result recorded as confirmed, refuted or unproven in the finding's evidence, with a refuted finding dropped and an unproven one stated as unproven rather than as fact
